video_title: NBA Refs Should Get FINED | Darius Garland & Lonzo Ball React | BITF Ep. 22

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball criticizes team identity and lack of playoff performance
quotes.excerpt: it's going to be hard to win when you don't have no identity.
quotes.quote: I didn't see it at all in the playoffs and to me, it's going to be hard to win when you don't have no identity.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball questions the wisdom of mid-season trades
quotes.excerpt: if you were trying to win a championship, I don't think that was a path that you should have taken.

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: If you were trying to win a championship, I don't think that was a path that you should have taken, personally. You asked me, I think we would have went further.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball critiques the team's roster management and player usage
quotes.excerpt: y'all traded people that you're not even using.
quotes.quote: Y'all traded people that you're not even using. Push Klay Thompson to the bench when he was killing all year, Kuminga didn't see the light of day. He's an energy guy.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on the transition to the Cavaliers' system
quotes.excerpt: come to a system where I can actually be me.
quotes.quote: It's been great, bro. Coming to a system where I can actually be me, had a ball in my hand for majority of the game and actually have control and pace of the game.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on playing alongside Donovan Mitchell
quotes.excerpt: I had the same thing when I got drafted with Collin Sexton.

text_blocks.speaker: Darius Garland
text_blocks.text: I was used to it for real, by the time he got there, because I had the same thing when I got drafted with Collin Sexton. It was the same exact thing for the first two, three years. Then Donovan Mitchell comes and it's the whole thing all over again.

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: Has anybody ever won switching a team midway?

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the impact of injuries on team potential
quotes.excerpt: we were never healthy, so it was like we never got to really see what it was.
quotes.quote: That's another thing, we were never healthy, so it was like we never got to really see what it was. But the few times that we did and that shit clicked, it was like, I don't see nobody in the East beating us.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball discusses LeBron James' potential return to Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: he's got a family and he's in LA. He's been here for the last X amount of years.
quotes.quote: I do, but I think it's hard, bro. He's got a family and he's in LA. He's been here for the last X amount of years. It's hard to just pack up and then go back to Cleveland.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the challenges of relying on LeBron James at 42
quotes.excerpt: you're asking a lot of a n**** that's 42.
quotes.quote: People got to realize that he is still 40, at that time he'll be what, 42? You're asking a lot of a n**** that's 42. Even if he is the greatest ever played, like he's still, come on bro.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on growing up as the son of an NBA player
quotes.excerpt: it's crazy though, I didn't even see my pops, bro.
quotes.quote: It's crazy though, I didn't even see my pops, bro. I didn't see my pops hoop or anything. So, I mean, I got all the love in Gary, like you have the crib, but I got to pull up DVR tapes to see my pops, bro.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on his first NBA game against Alfred Payton
quotes.excerpt: my first game in the Garden, Alfred Payton, bro.
quotes.quote: My first game in the Garden, Alfred Payton, bro. That's when he had the crazy hair and shit. He was going crazy. Bro, he had a triple double on me.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the 'one love' phrase LiAngelo uses
quotes.excerpt: What's up with that nigga always saying one when he leaves now?

text_blocks.text: What's up with that nigga always saying one when he leaves now?

text_blocks.text: One love. That shit is low-key, he just started that recently.
